source_title: IndexCache: Accelerating Sparse Attention via Cross-Layer Index Reuse

concepts.label: indexcache framework
concepts.description: A novel framework that accelerates sparse attention by partitioning transformer layers into 'Full' layers (which compute indices) and 'Shared' layers (which reuse indices from a preceding 'Full' layer).
concepts.why_innovative: It addresses the O(L^2) bottleneck of sparse attention indexers in long-context LLMs by eliminating redundant computations, leading to significant speedups.

concepts.label: cross-layer index reuse
concepts.description: The core principle that top-k token selections are highly stable across consecutive transformer layers, enabling indexer computations to be skipped and reused.
concepts.why_innovative: This insight extends the known cross-layer stability to sparse attention indexers, allowing for substantial computational savings without relying on a full attention mechanism.

concepts.label: training-free indexcache
concepts.description: An approach to configure IndexCache on existing sparse attention models without requiring any costly retraining or weight updates.
concepts.why_innovative: It provides an immediate and practical way to enhance the efficiency of already deployed sparse attention models by adapting the indexer pattern post-training.

concepts.label: greedy layer selection algorithm
concepts.description: An algorithm used in training-free IndexCache that iteratively identifies and converts 'Full' layers to 'Shared' layers by minimizing language modeling loss on a calibration set.
concepts.why_innovative: This data-driven approach intelligently prioritizes which indexers to retain, outperforming naive uniform reuse by adapting to the varying importance of different layers.

concepts.label: training-aware indexcache
concepts.description: An approach that integrates IndexCache optimization directly into the model training pipeline, either from scratch or via continued pre-training.
concepts.why_innovative: By optimizing the indexers during training, it allows for more aggressive index reuse patterns while maintaining or even improving model quality compared to standard per-layer indexers.

concepts.label: multi-layer distillation loss
concepts.description: A novel loss function for training-aware IndexCache where each retained indexer is optimized to predict top-k tokens that are jointly useful for all the subsequent layers it serves.
concepts.why_innovative: It enables indexers to learn a 'consensus' top-k selection, providing a robust and theoretically justified method to generalize indexer capabilities across multiple layers.
